name: Vindhya Pradesh
alt: Union of Baghelkhand and Bundelkhand States

predecessors.name: Rewa State
predecessors.text: Rewa, the Baghelkhand plateau (the rewa-state dossier's outline of the Rewa State of 33,670 km2)

predecessors.name: Central India Agency
predecessors.text: the Bundelkhand states (Panna, Chhatarpur, Datia, Orchha and others) and the small Baghelkhand states (Maihar, Nagod, Samthar...)

successors.name: Republic of India
successors.text: Vindhya Pradesh, 61,131.5 km2: the eastern princely states of the former Central India Agency, the Baghelkhand division (Rewa, Nagod, Maihar, and the rest of the plateau) and the Bundelkhand division…

ledger.x: 12 March 1948: the Union of Baghelkhand and Bundelkhand States, later Vindhya Pradesh, is formed from the eastern princely states of the Central India Agency.
12 March 1948: Rewa merges into the new union.

ledger.cp: the other thirty-five princely states of the eastern Central India Agency (Panna, Datia, Orchha, Chhatarpur, Charkhari, Maihar, Nagod, Samthar named)

ledger.x: 1 January 1950: the union becomes the Part C state of Vindhya Pradesh under a Chief Commissioner.
1 November 1956: Vindhya Pradesh is merged into Madhya Pradesh.

certainty.note: A state of the Indian Union with administrative boundaries (eight districts), but the page gives no outline: the drawn edge follows the Rewa outline and discs and is approximate; Charkhari and Samthar are left out.
